trap.label: have a say
trap.wrong: Students want to have a word on the plan.
trap.right: Students want to have a say in the plan.
trap.why: Em português “ter voz/palavra”. Em inglês, a colocação é have a say (in).

mcq.q: Students want a ___ in the plan.
It will ___ an impact on exams.

fix.wrong: It will do an impact on exams.
fix.right: It will have an impact on exams.

fix.wrong: Students want a say of the plan.
fix.right: Students want a say in the plan.
It has an impact on exams.

rewrite.prompt: Use have a say: “Students want to take part in deciding.”
Use have an impact on: “It affects exams.”
rewrite.answer: It will have an impact on exams.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “It has an impact on exams.”
rewrite.answer: It had an impact on exams.
